distinguishing_features: FFKM elastomer ring as the primary sealing contact instead of a metal or nickel-alloy seat.
Spring-preloaded conical seat stack with a pressure-coupled annulus that increases elastomer contact pressure as internal pressure rises.
Thin high-stiffness Inconel 718 annulus structurally backing the elastomer while being decoupled from main stem load.
Cone angle and friction selection satisfying a self-energizing condition, with alpha about 10 degrees and mu about 0.3.
